# Embassy 4.7.1

Fixes Codex connectivity after upgrading the managed App Server to 0.158.0.
That release can relocate its control socket behind a symbolic link. Embassy
now accepts one owned link to an owned 0600 socket in a canonical owned 0700
directory, connects the proxy to that validated target, and checks link/socket
generations before and after the handshake. Unsafe or chained links still
refuse; Embassy never changes provider permissions.

Discovery and metadata-only loaded/live recovery attestation passed against
the laptop's running 0.158.0 daemon. No model turn, resume, STEER, or daemon
restart was performed for that check. Older direct-socket layouts remain
supported. No protocol, state-schema, or configuration change is required.
